method: Each official NCREC brochure-format PDF was obtained through the Commission's rendered Publications page, text-extracted, rendered page-by-page with Poppler, and visually inspected in full. The Commission's separate text-only PDFs were also retained and extracted so that multi-column reading order could be checked without using OCR.

artifacts.title: Questions and Answers on: Working With Real Estate Agents
artifacts.reviewObservation: Both six-panel brochure pages are legible and complete. Headings, Q&A text, agency diagrams, Commission contact information, revision footer and front/back artwork are visible without clipping or overlap.
